reviews.title: The game CHEATS
reviews.text: Cheater, cheater, cheater!!! I’ve played this game every other day or so for 15 to 30 minutes each session for the past three months. Many times I selected words that I thought went together only to hear the ‘bonk’ indicating I was wrong. A couple days ago I decided that I would pay the 100 coins* to reveal the one incorrect word. Every two or three times I spent my coins, there was no highlighted ‘wrong’ word, and if I tapped the bar again, the game relieved me of another 100 coins and still did not show the wrong word. I decided to leave those four blocks for the last connection - and it was right every time!!!! I wasted all that coin for nothing. If the game is going to cheat, I refuse to play it, and you should, too!!!
